mn107:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati pubbārāme migāramātu pāsāde.
mn107:1.3: atha kho gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
mn107:1.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn107:2.1: seyyathāpi bho gotama imassa migāramātu pāsādassa dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ
mn107:2.3: imesampi hi bho gotama brāhmaṇānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ
mn107:2.5: imesampi hi bho gotama issāsānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ
mn107:2.7: amhākampi hi bho gotama gaṇakānaṃ gaṇanājīvānaṃ dissati anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā yadidaṃ
mn107:2.9: mayaṃ hi bho gotama antevāsī labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ gaṇāpema
mn107:2.10: ekaṃ ekakaṃ dve dukā tīṇi tikā cattāri catukkā pañca pañcakā satta sattakā aṭṭha aṭṭhakā nava navakā dasa dasakāti
mn107:2.12: sakkā nu kho bho gotama imasmiṃpi dhammavinaye evameva anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññāpetunti.
mn107:3.1: sakkā brāhmaṇa imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā paññāpetuṃ.
mn107:3.2: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa dakkho assadamako bhaddaṃ assājānīyaṃ labhitvā paṭhameneva mukhādhāne kāraṇaṃ kāreti atha uttariṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti
mn107:3.3: evameva kho brāhmaṇa tathāgato purisadammaṃ labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ vineti
mn107:3.4: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlavā hohi pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesūti.
mn107:4.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti
mn107:4.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hohi cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhī hohi mā anubyañjanaggāhī
mn107:4.3: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ cakkhundriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjāhi rakkhāhi cakkhundriyaṃ cakkhundriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjāhi.
mn107:4.8: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya mā nimittaggāhī hohi mā anubyañjanaggāhī
mn107:4.9: yatvādhikaraṇamenaṃ manindriyaṃ asaṃvutaṃ viharantaṃ abhijjhādomanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjāhi rakkhāhi manindriyaṃ manindriye saṃvaraṃ āpajjāhīti.
mn107:5.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu indriyesu guttadvāro hoti tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti
mn107:5.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hohi
mn107:5.4: neva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāvadeva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃsuparatiyā brahmacariyānuggahāya iti purāṇañca vedanaṃ paṭihaṅkhāmi navañca vedanaṃ na uppādessāmi yātrā ca me bhavissati anavajjatā ca phāsuvihāro cāti.
mn107:6.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu bhojane mattaññū hoti tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti
mn107:6.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto viharāhi divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehi rattiyā paṭhamaṃ yāmaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehi rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeyyāsi pādena pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikatvā rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehīti.
mn107:7.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu jāgariyaṃ anuyutto hoti tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti
mn107:7.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hohi abhikkante paṭikkante sampajānakārī ālokite vilokite sampajānakārī sammiñjite pasārite sampajānakārī saṅghāṭipattacīvaradhāraṇe sampajānakārī asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārīti.
mn107:8.1: yato kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhu satisampajaññena samannāgato hoti tamenaṃ tathāgato uttariṃ vineti
mn107:8.2: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhaja araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjanti.
mn107:9.1: so vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkhamūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giriguhaṃ susānaṃ vanapatthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palālapuñjaṃ.
mn107:9.2: so pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
mn107:9.3: so abhijjhaṃ loke pahāya vigatābhijjhena cetasā viharati abhijjhāya cittaṃ parisodheti
mn107:9.4: byāpādapadosaṃ pahāya abyāpannacitto viharati sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī byāpādapadosā cittaṃ parisodheti
mn107:9.5: thīnamiddhaṃ pahāya vigatathīnamiddho viharati ālokasaññī sato sampajāno thīnamiddhā cittaṃ parisodheti
mn107:9.6: uddhaccakukkuccaṃ pahāya anuddhato viharati ajjhattaṃ vūpasantacitto uddhaccakukkuccā cittaṃ parisodheti
mn107:9.7: vicikicchaṃ pahāya tiṇṇavicikiccho viharati akathaṃkathī kusalesu dhammesu vicikicchāya cittaṃ parisodheti.
mn107:10.1: so ime pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe
mn107:10.2: vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakukaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn107:10.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn107:10.4: pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
mn107:10.5: sukhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn107:11.1: ye te kho brāhmaṇa bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti tesu me ayaṃ evarūpī anusāsanī hoti.
mn107:11.2: ye pana te bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññā vimuttā tesaṃ ime dhammā diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattanti satisampajaññāya cāti.
mn107:12.1: evaṃ vutte gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn107:12.2: kinnu kho bhoto gotamassa sāvakā bhotā gotamena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā sabbeva accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti udāhu ekacce nārādhentīti.
mn107:12.3: appekacce kho brāhmaṇa mama sāvakā mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti ekacce nārādhentīti.
mn107:13.1: ko nu kho bho gotama hetu ko paccayo yantiṭṭhateva nibbānaṃ tiṭṭhati nibbānagāmimaggo tiṭṭhati bhavaṃ gotamo samādapetā
mn107:13.2: atha ca pana bhoto gotamassa sāvakā bhotā gotamena evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā appekacce accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti ekacce nārādhentīti.
mn107:14.1: tenahi brāhmaṇa taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi yathā te khameyya yathā naṃ byākareyyāsi
mn107:14.4: evaṃ bho kusalo ahaṃ rājagahagāmissa maggassāti.
mn107:14.11: ehambho purisa ayaṃ maggo rājagahaṃ gacchati
mn107:14.12: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ tena muhuttaṃ gaccha tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma nigamaṃ
mn107:14.13: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi rājagahassa ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇirāmaṇeyyakanti.
mn107:14.14: so tayā evaṃ ovadiyamāno evaṃ anusāsiyamāno ummaggaṃ gahetvā pacchāmukho gaccheyya.
mn107:14.15: atha dutiyo puriso āgaccheyya rājagahaṃ gantukāmo.
mn107:14.20: ehambho purisa ayaṃ maggo rājagahaṃ gacchati
mn107:14.21: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma gāmaṃ
mn107:14.22: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi amukaṃ nāma nigamaṃ
mn107:14.23: tena muhuttaṃ gaccha tena muhuttaṃ gantvā dakkhissasi rājagahassa ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇirāmaṇeyyakanti.
mn107:14.24: so tayā evaṃ ovadiyamāno evaṃ anusāsiyamāno sotthinā rājagahaṃ gaccheyya.
mn107:14.25: ko nu kho brāhmaṇa hetu ko paccayo yantiṭṭhateva rājagahaṃ tiṭṭhati rājagahagāmimaggo tiṭṭhasi tvaṃ samādapetā
mn107:14.26: atha ca pana tayā evaṃ ovadiyamāno evaṃ anusāsiyamāno eko puriso ummaggaṃ gahetvā pacchāmukho gaccheyya eko sotthinā rājagahaṃ gaccheyyāti.
mn107:14.29: evameva kho brāhmaṇa tiṭṭhateva nibbānaṃ tiṭṭhati nibbānagāmimaggo tiṭṭhāmahaṃ samādapetā
mn107:14.30: atha ca pana mama sāvakā mayā evaṃ ovadiyamānā evaṃ anusāsiyamānā appekacce accantaniṭṭhaṃ nibbānaṃ ārādhenti ekacce nārādhenti
mn107:15.1: evaṃ vutte gaṇakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn107:15.2: yeme bho gotama puggalā asaddhā jīvikatthā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā saṭhā māyāvino keṭubhino uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā indriyesu aguttadvārā bhojane amattaññuno jāgariyaṃ ananuyuttā sāmaññe anapekkhavanto sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhullikā sāthilikā okkamane pubbaṅgamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā kusītā hīnaviriyā muṭṭhasatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā duppaññā elamūgā na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
mn107:15.3: ye pana te kulaputtā saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā asaṭhā amāyāvino akeṭubhino anuddhatā anunnaḷā acapalā amukharā avikiṇṇavācā indriyesu guttadvārā bhojane mattaññuno jāgariyaṃ anuyuttā sāmaññe apekkhavanto sikkhāya tibbagāravā na bāhullikā na sāthilikā okkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅgamā āraddhaviriyā pahitattā upaṭṭhitasatino sampajānā samāhitā ekaggacittā paññavanto anelamūgā tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
mn107:16.1: seyyathāpi bho gotama yekeci mūlagandhā kāḷānusārikaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati
mn107:16.4: evameva kho bhoto gotamassa ovādo paramajjadhammesu
mn107:17.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn107:17.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn107:17.3: esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn107:17.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti.
